name: Brawn
body:
You prefer a more direct approach to combat.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 7th, minotaur.

Benefit: The critical multiplier of weapons you wield increases by 1 (from x2 to x3, and so on). This effect doesn’t stack with any other effect that expands the critical multiplier of a weapon.
